TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.TITLE: Telegram — personal account
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.DESCRIPTION: Connect your Telegram number by scanning a QR code. Agents reply as your account.
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.NAME: Inbox name
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.SCAN: On the account's phone: Telegram → Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device. Scan this code.
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.QR_REFRESH: The code refreshes automatically. Scan with the account matching this inbox's number.
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.APP_ONCE: The server's Telegram application is configured once. New accounts only need QR pairing and their two-step password, if enabled.
TELEGRAM_PERSONAL.SAVED: Settings saved. They apply to this account immediately.

STATUS.password: This account requires its two-step verification password

ERRORS.service_unavailable: The connection service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
ERRORS.application_not_configured: A server administrator must configure the Telegram application once using the link below.
ERRORS.connection_failed: Could not connect to Telegram. Try connecting again.
ERRORS.wrong_account: The scanned account does not match this inbox's number. Scan with the correct account.
ERRORS.session_expired: Telegram revoked or expired this session. Connect again using QR.
ERRORS.qr_expired: Pairing timed out. Generate a new QR code.
ERRORS.invalid_password: Incorrect two-step verification password. Try again.
ERRORS.password_not_required: Refresh the connection status before submitting a password.
ERRORS.disconnect_before_changing_number: Disconnect this account before changing its number.
ERRORS.not_connected: Connect this account before sending messages.
ERRORS.flood_wait: Telegram requested a pause. Try again after the indicated wait.
ERRORS.telegram_rejected_message: Telegram could not send this message.
ERRORS.delivery_unconfirmed: Delivery confirmation is pending. Retry the same message.
ERRORS.file_too_large: Attachments may total up to 50 MB per message.
ERRORS.invalid_file: This attachment could not be read.
ERRORS.empty_message: Enter a message or add a file.

ignore_groups.LABEL: Ignore new group messages
ignore_groups.DESCRIPTION: Stops importing new messages. Existing conversations stay stored.

ignore_channels.LABEL: Ignore new channel messages
ignore_channels.DESCRIPTION: Stops importing new messages. Existing conversations stay stored.

hide_groups.LABEL: Hide existing group conversations
hide_groups.DESCRIPTION: Hides conversations from the list without deleting history. Turn off to show them again.

hide_channels.LABEL: Hide existing channel conversations
hide_channels.DESCRIPTION: Hides conversations from the list without deleting history. Turn off to show them again.
